verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is offered exclusively as a cloud API (with an optional 'dedicated endpoint' that is still Cerebras-hosted, provisioned and managed by them, not deployable on customer-owned infrastructure). No evidence of any self-hostable software, model weights, or on-prem deployment option; community comments even note it as a 'tightly controlled API' with a waitlist, reinforcing its closed, hosted-only nature.
